step G35 of the content expansion, ten data rows (Thunder Punch, X-Scissor, Lumina Crash, Overdrive, Scorching Sands, Leaf Blade, Boomburst, Sludge Wave, Volt Tackle, Discharge) and two small rules (Rain Dish and Friend Guard): the marks, that the two abilities are engine rows, the flags of the data rows that other rules read (punch, slicing, sound), and Gigaton Hammer, left out of the step, unmarked because no learner of it has a marked ability (the day one has, this test fails). The recorded battles g35_* are replayed by duoforge.reference.conformance_pool_data.

Split by subject from the test of step G35 (restructure step 6e; tests/renames.tsv maps the old name).

step G35 of the content expansion, the ModifyDamage chain with Friend Guard as an eighth modifier: dfi_mods_commute is compared with a brute force over all orders for every subset that one hit can have (143 subsets, 85 of them commute, the 58 that do not are refused by the engine, E_UNSUPPORTED), and the engine's refusal itself is played on g35_friend_guard.

Split by subject from the test of step G35 (restructure step 6e; tests/renames.tsv maps the old name).
